observations: Front-load LG washer/dryer unit, silver finish, on wheeled pedestal/drawer
Control panel is illuminated: digital timer display and dial ring lit with amber lights
Drum door glass shows damp pink fabric inside, suggesting it was recently used or mid-cycle
Text on fascia reads 'LG INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg'
Exposed loose wiring/cable hanging down the right side near the wall
Wall behind unit shows heavy water staining/damp and peeling paint
No plate or rating label with full model number is visible

identity.model: DirectDrive 6/3kg (series, exact model number not legible)

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the control panel and dial fully illuminated with a lit display, which indicates the unit is receiving power and some electronics are active, inconsistent with a fully dead 'scrap' unit; however actual wash/spin/drain function is not shown

risks.risk: Motor, drum bearing, or drive function may be seized or non-operational despite panel power
risks.proof: A video clip of a wash cycle running, including drum rotation and water fill/drain

risks.risk: Water inlet valve, drain pump, or door lock could be faulty
risks.proof: Clip showing door locking and water draining at end of cycle

risks.risk: Electrical safety issue from exposed/loose wiring and damp wall proximity
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the wiring connection and any frayed insulation
risks.if_unproven: priced as higher-risk, deduct for potential rewiring/safety repair

risks.risk: Internal rust or water damage to electronics from the damp wall environment
risks.proof: Photo of the rear panel and internal control board

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories (hoses, power cable, detergent drawer)
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the unit showing hose and cable connections
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, no added value for accessories

proof_requests: Video of the machine attempting a wash cycle (drum turning, water filling/draining)
Clear photo of the rating plate/model-serial sticker (usually inside door rim or on rear)
Photo of the rear of the machine showing power cable, hoses, and vent
Close-up of the exposed wiring seen hanging on the right side
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an LG front-load washer/dryer combo, and despite the seller's claim it doesn't work, the lit panel is unverified proof of real function, so per rule it is priced at the worst case as non-working scrap until a working demonstration is provided.
